source.name: kb curated topic map
source.note: Lessons, design-console case studies and curated resources; topics without a lesson link to their topic page.

topics.name: How to approach a design interview
topics.usage: Requirements → estimates → API → data model → high-level design → deep dives → trade-offs.

topics.name: Back-of-the-envelope estimation
topics.usage: QPS, storage, bandwidth and memory estimates from a few assumptions.

topics.name: Scaling from zero to millions
topics.usage: Vertical vs horizontal scaling, stateless services, the path from one box to many.

topics.name: Latency, throughput and availability
topics.usage: Latency numbers, percentiles, SLAs/SLOs, nines of availability.

topics.name: CAP, PACELC and consistency models
topics.usage: Strong vs eventual consistency, quorum reads/writes, trade-offs under partitions.

topics.name: Networking: DNS, HTTP, TCP/UDP, WebSockets
topics.usage: How requests reach a service; long polling vs SSE vs WebSockets.

topics.name: API design: REST, gRPC, GraphQL
topics.usage: Resource modelling, pagination, idempotency, versioning.

topics.name: Load balancing
topics.usage: L4 vs L7, algorithms, health checks, sticky sessions.

topics.name: Caching
topics.usage: Cache-aside / write-through / write-back, eviction, invalidation, hot keys.

topics.name: CDN and edge
topics.usage: Push vs pull CDNs, cache control, serving static and video content.

topics.name: Databases: SQL vs NoSQL
topics.usage: Relational vs key-value / document / wide-column / graph; choosing a store.

topics.name: Indexes and storage engines
topics.usage: B-trees vs LSM trees, secondary indexes, write vs read amplification.

topics.name: Replication
topics.usage: Leader-follower, multi-leader, leaderless; replication lag.

topics.name: Sharding and partitioning
topics.usage: Range vs hash partitioning, rebalancing, hot partitions.

topics.name: Consistent hashing
topics.usage: Hash ring, virtual nodes, minimal remapping.

topics.name: Message queues and event streaming
topics.usage: Queues vs logs (Kafka), delivery semantics, back-pressure, DLQs.

topics.name: Rate limiting
topics.usage: Token bucket, leaky bucket, sliding window; distributed counters.

topics.name: Unique ID generation
topics.usage: UUIDs, Snowflake IDs, ticket servers; ordering vs coordination.

topics.name: Blob / object storage
topics.usage: Chunking, metadata vs data, durability via replication or erasure coding.

topics.name: Search and inverted indexes
topics.usage: Tokenisation, inverted index, ranking, typeahead tries.

topics.name: Microservices and service communication
topics.usage: Sync vs async calls, service discovery, API gateway, sagas.

topics.name: Monitoring, logging and tracing
topics.usage: Metrics, logs, traces, alerting; designing for operability.

topics.name: Authentication and authorization
topics.usage: Sessions vs tokens, OAuth/OIDC, secrets, encryption in transit/at rest.

topics.name: Probabilistic data structures
topics.usage: Bloom filters, HyperLogLog, count-min sketch: approximate answers in tiny memory.

topics.name: Consensus and coordination
topics.usage: Leader election, Raft/Paxos, ZooKeeper-style coordination, clocks.

topics.name: Distributed transactions
topics.usage: 2PC, sagas, the outbox pattern, idempotency across services.

topics.name: Batch and stream processing
topics.usage: MapReduce/Spark vs streaming (Kafka/Flink), CDC, lambda vs kappa.

topics.name: Redis
topics.usage: In-memory key-value store: cache, counters, sorted sets (leaderboards), locks with TTL, pub/sub, geo.

topics.name: Kafka
topics.usage: Partitioned, replicated append-only log: durable event bus, replay, per-partition ordering, consumer groups.

topics.name: PostgreSQL / relational DB
topics.usage: ACID transactions, constraints, secondary indexes, row locks; the default for money, inventory and anything needing joins.

topics.name: Cassandra / wide-column stores
topics.usage: Write-optimised, partition-key + clustering-key tables, tunable consistency, linear scale for time-ordered data.

topics.name: DynamoDB / managed key-value
topics.usage: Managed partitioned key-value/document store: single-digit ms by key, conditional writes, TTL, streams.

topics.name: Elasticsearch / search engines
topics.usage: Inverted indexes over sharded documents: full-text search, ranking, filters and aggregations.

topics.name: Object storage (S3)
topics.usage: Cheap, durable blobs by key: media, files, backups; multipart and presigned uploads; pairs with a CDN.

topics.name: ZooKeeper / etcd
topics.usage: Small strongly-consistent store for coordination: leader election, leases, membership, config.

topics.name: Flink / stream processors
topics.usage: Stateful stream processing with windows, watermarks and exactly-once checkpoints.

topics.name: WebSockets / SSE / long polling
topics.usage: Server push over long-lived connections; gateways keep the sockets, a registry maps user → gateway.

topics.name: Time-series databases
topics.usage: Append-heavy storage for (series, timestamp, value) with compression, downsampling and retention.

topics.name: Load balancers & proxies (Nginx, Envoy)
topics.usage: L4/L7 routing, TLS termination, health checks, retries and rate limits in front of services.

topics.name: Fan-out on write vs on read
topics.usage: Precompute per-recipient results on write (fast reads) or merge at read time (cheap writes); hybrid for celebrities.

topics.name: CQRS & materialised views
topics.usage: Separate the write model from read-optimised views fed by events.

topics.name: Event sourcing
topics.usage: Store the ordered log of changes as the source of truth; state is a fold over events.

topics.name: Transactional outbox
topics.usage: Write the row and the event in one DB transaction; a relay publishes the event — no dual-write loss.

topics.name: Sagas
topics.usage: A long business transaction as local steps with compensations instead of a distributed lock/2PC.

topics.name: Idempotency keys & dedup
topics.usage: Make retries safe: a client-chosen key stored with the result; at-least-once delivery + dedup = effectively once.

topics.name: Distributed locks, leases & holds
topics.usage: Short-lived exclusive ownership with a TTL and fencing tokens (seat holds, job claims, leader leases).

topics.name: Optimistic concurrency (CAS / versions)
topics.usage: Conditional writes on a version or expected value; retry on conflict instead of holding locks.

topics.name: Scatter-gather
topics.usage: Fan a query out to every shard/partition and merge the top results.

topics.name: Geospatial indexing
topics.usage: Geohash / quadtree / H3 cells turn 'near me' into key lookups over a few neighbouring cells.

topics.name: Direct-to-storage uploads
topics.usage: Clients upload/download blobs straight to object storage with short-lived signed URLs; services handle metadata only.

topics.name: Chunking & content hashing
topics.usage: Split files into content-addressed chunks: resumable uploads, delta sync, dedup.

topics.name: Real-time push & pub/sub fan-out
topics.usage: Connection gateways + a pub/sub channel per topic/room deliver events to online clients.

topics.name: Hot keys & sharded counters
topics.usage: Split a hot key across N sub-keys, cache it locally, or coalesce requests so one key can't melt a shard.

topics.name: Pre-aggregation & rollups
topics.usage: Aggregate on ingest into time buckets (1m→1h→1d) so queries read small summaries.

topics.name: Retries, backoff & dead-letter queues
topics.usage: Bounded retries with exponential backoff and jitter; poison messages go to a DLQ for inspection.

topics.name: Backpressure, admission control & waiting rooms
topics.usage: Protect the core by queueing or shedding excess load at the edge (virtual queues, token buckets).

topics.name: OT & CRDTs
topics.usage: Merge concurrent edits deterministically: operational transform with a central server, or CRDTs.

topics.name: OLAP stores (ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid)
topics.usage: Columnar stores for fast aggregations over huge event tables: slice-and-dice dashboards, rollups.

topics.name: Batch processing (Spark, MapReduce)
topics.usage: Large offline jobs over logs and snapshots: index builds, reconciliation, backfills.

topics.name: Task queues (SQS, RabbitMQ)
topics.usage: Per-message delivery with acks and visibility timeouts: work distribution, retries, DLQs.

topics.name: Change data capture (CDC)
topics.usage: Stream a database's committed changes (binlog/WAL) to caches, search indexes and other services.

topics.name: Double-entry ledger
topics.usage: Every money movement is two balanced, immutable entries; balances are derived and auditable.

topics.name: State machines & durable workflows
topics.usage: Model long-running processes as explicit states and transitions persisted with each step; resume after crashes.

topics.name: Circuit breakers, timeouts & bulkheads
topics.usage: Stop calling a failing dependency, fail fast and isolate resources so one slow dependency can't sink the system.

topics.name: Relational databases
topics.usage: Tables, joins, ACID transactions and a query planner: the default store until a requirement rules it out.

topics.name: Transactions & isolation levels
topics.usage: ACID, read committed vs repeatable read vs serializable, and the anomalies each one allows.

topics.name: Key-value stores
topics.usage: Get/put by key at very low latency; partitioned by key, no joins, access patterns designed up front.

topics.name: Document stores
topics.usage: JSON documents with flexible schema and secondary indexes; good when one entity is read and written whole.

topics.name: Wide-column stores
topics.usage: Partition key + clustering key, write-optimised LSM storage, tunable consistency: time-ordered data at scale.

topics.name: Graph databases
topics.usage: Nodes and edges with index-free traversal for many-hop relationship queries.

topics.name: Vector databases
topics.usage: Store embeddings and answer nearest-neighbour queries with ANN indexes (HNSW, IVF); the retrieval layer of RAG.

topics.name: Performance optimization
topics.usage: Find the bottleneck first (measure), then fix it: caching, batching, indexing, async work, fewer round trips.

topics.name: Connection pooling
topics.usage: Reuse expensive connections (DB, HTTP/2, gRPC) instead of opening one per request; size pools to the backend.

topics.name: Batching & async I/O
topics.usage: Group small operations and overlap waiting: higher throughput at the cost of a little latency.

topics.name: Load testing & profiling
topics.usage: Measure before and after: load tests find the knee of the latency curve, profilers find where time goes.
